a.xlink:title: --- stage: build variables: BUILD_TARGET: production BUILD_FLAGS: "-O2 -Wall" OUTPUT_DIR: build/${BUILD_VERSION} ARTIFACT_NAME: "${CI_PROJECT_NAME}-${BUILD_VERSION}-${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}" script: - echo "=== Building Application ===" - echo "Build version ${BUILD_VERSION}" - echo "Build target ${BUILD_TARGET}" - echo "Build flags ${BUILD_FLAGS}" - echo "Output directory ${OUTPUT_DIR}" - echo "Artifact name ${ARTIFACT_NAME}" - echo "Docker image will be ${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${BUILD_VERSION}" - echo "" - echo "Creating build directory..." - mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" - echo "Build completed at $(date)" > "${OUTPUT_DIR}/build-info.txt" - echo "Commit ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" >> "${OUTPUT_DIR}/build-info.txt" - echo "Branch ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}" >> "${OUTPUT_DIR}/build-info.txt" artifacts: paths: - build/ expire_in: 1 hour

--- stage: vars_test variables: JOB_VAR: job_specific_value COMBINED_VAR: "${GLOBAL_VAR}_${JOB_VAR}" script: - echo "=== Testing Variable Expansion ===" - echo "Global variable GLOBAL_VAR = ${GLOBAL_VAR}" - echo "Job-specific variable JOB_VAR = ${JOB_VAR}" - echo "Combined variable COMBINED_VAR = ${COMBINED_VAR}" - echo "" - echo "=== Testing Predefined GitLab CI Variables ===" - echo "CI_COMMIT_SHA = ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" - echo "CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA = ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}" - echo "CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME = ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}" - echo "CI_COMMIT_BRANCH = ${CI_COMMIT_BRANCH}" - echo "CI_PROJECT_NAME = ${CI_PROJECT_NAME}" - echo "CI_PROJECT_PATH = ${CI_PROJECT_PATH}" - echo "CI_PROJECT_DIR = ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}" - echo "CI_PIPELINE_ID = ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}" - echo "CI_JOB_ID = ${CI_JOB_ID}" - echo "CI_JOB_NAME = ${CI_JOB_NAME}" - echo "CI_JOB_STAGE = ${CI_JOB_STAGE}" - echo "CI_RUNNER_ID = ${CI_RUNNER_ID}" - echo "CI_SERVER_HOST = ${CI_SERVER_HOST}" - echo "CI_SERVER_VERSION = ${CI_SERVER_VERSION}" - echo "GITLAB_USER_LOGIN = ${GITLAB_USER_LOGIN}" - echo "GITLAB_USER_EMAIL = ${GITLAB_USER_EMAIL}"

--- stage: vars_test variables: ORIGINAL_VAR: hello_world UPPERCASE_TEST: UPPERCASE LOWERCASE_TEST: lowercase PATH_VAR: "/home/user/project" URL_VAR: https://example.com/path NESTED_VAR_1: "${GLOBAL_VAR}" NESTED_VAR_2: "${NESTED_VAR_1}_nested" COMPLEX_VAR: "${CI_PROJECT_NAME}-${BUILD_VERSION}-${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}-${NESTED_VAR_2}" script: - echo "=== Testing Complex Variable Expansion ===" - echo "Original variable ORIGINAL_VAR = ${ORIGINAL_VAR}" - echo "Uppercase test UPPERCASE_TEST = ${UPPERCASE_TEST}" - echo "Lowercase test LOWERCASE_TEST = ${LOWERCASE_TEST}" - echo "Path variable PATH_VAR = ${PATH_VAR}" - echo "URL variable URL_VAR = ${URL_VAR}" - echo "" - echo "=== Testing Nested Variable Expansion ===" - echo "NESTED_VAR_1 = ${NESTED_VAR_1}" - echo "NESTED_VAR_2 = ${NESTED_VAR_2}" - echo "COMPLEX_VAR = ${COMPLEX_VAR}" - echo "" - echo "=== Testing Variables in Commands ===" - export COMPUTED_VAR="${CI_PROJECT_NAME}_${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}" - echo "Computed variable COMPUTED_VAR = ${COMPUTED_VAR}" - echo "${COMPUTED_VAR}" > /tmp/computed_var.txt - cat /tmp/computed_var.txt - rm /tmp/computed_var.txt

--- stage: vars_test variables: ENV_TYPE: production DEBUG_MODE: 'false' CACHE_ENABLED: 'true' MONITORING_ENABLED: 'true' METRICS_PORT: '9090' HEALTH_CHECK_PATH: "/health" READY_CHECK_PATH: "/ready" script: - echo "=== Environment-Specific Configuration ===" - echo "Environment type ${ENV_TYPE}" - echo "Debug mode ${DEBUG_MODE}" - echo "Cache enabled ${CACHE_ENABLED}" - echo "Monitoring enabled ${MONITORING_ENABLED}" - echo "Metrics port ${METRICS_PORT}" - echo "Health check ${HEALTH_CHECK_PATH}" - echo "Ready check ${READY_CHECK_PATH}" - echo "" - echo "Full service URL http://${DEPLOY_HOST:-localhost}:${METRICS_PORT}${HEALTH_CHECK_PATH}"

--- stage: vars_test variables: GLOBAL_VAR: overridden_at_job_level PRECEDENCE_TEST: job_level_value script: - echo "=== Testing Variable Precedence ===" - echo "GLOBAL_VAR (should be overridden) = ${GLOBAL_VAR}" - echo "PRECEDENCE_TEST (job-level) = ${PRECEDENCE_TEST}" - echo "" - echo "=== Setting Runtime Variables ===" - export RUNTIME_VAR="runtime_value" - echo "RUNTIME_VAR = ${RUNTIME_VAR}" - export GLOBAL_VAR="runtime_override" - echo "GLOBAL_VAR (runtime override) = ${GLOBAL_VAR}"

--- stage: test variables: TEST_ENV: unit TEST_TIMEOUT: "${TIMEOUT_SECONDS}" TEST_LOG_LEVEL: debug TEST_RESULTS_DIR: test-results/${CI_JOB_NAME} COVERAGE_TARGET: '80' script: - echo "=== Running Unit Tests ===" - echo "Test environment ${TEST_ENV}" - echo "Test timeout ${TEST_TIMEOUT} seconds" - echo "Log level ${TEST_LOG_LEVEL}" - echo "Results directory ${TEST_RESULTS_DIR}" - echo "Coverage target ${COVERAGE_TARGET}%" - echo "" - echo "Running tests for commit ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}" - echo "Pipeline ID ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}" - echo "Job ID ${CI_JOB_ID}" - mkdir -p "${TEST_RESULTS_DIR}" - echo "Test passed" > "${TEST_RESULTS_DIR}/results.txt" artifacts: paths: - test-results/ expire_in: 1 day needs: - build_app

--- stage: test variables: TEST_ENV: integration TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://localhost/${CI_PROJECT_NAME}_test TEST_REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/1 API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000/api RETRY_COUNT: "${MAX_RETRIES}" script: - echo "=== Running Integration Tests ===" - echo "Test environment ${TEST_ENV}" - echo "Database URL ${TEST_DATABASE_URL}" - echo "Redis URL ${TEST_REDIS_URL}" - echo "API base URL ${API_BASE_URL}" - echo "Max retries ${RETRY_COUNT}" - echo "" - echo "Testing integration for ${CI_PROJECT_NAME}" - echo "Branch ${CI_COMMIT_BRANCH}" - echo "Commit ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" needs: - build_app

--- stage: deploy variables: DEPLOY_ENV: "${DEPLOYMENT_ENV}" DEPLOY_HOST: staging.example.com DEPLOY_USER: deployer DEPLOY_PATH: "/var/www/${APP_NAME}" DOCKER_TAG: "${BUILD_VERSION}-${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}" DEPLOY_IMAGE: "${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${DOCKER_TAG}" CONFIG_FILE: "${CONFIG_PATH}/config.yml" script: - echo "=== Deploying to Staging ===" - echo "Environment ${DEPLOY_ENV}" - echo "Host ${DEPLOY_HOST}" - echo "User ${DEPLOY_USER}" - echo "Deploy path ${DEPLOY_PATH}" - echo "Docker image ${DEPLOY_IMAGE}" - echo "Config file ${CONFIG_FILE}" - echo "" - echo "Deploying ${CI_PROJECT_NAME} version ${BUILD_VERSION}" - echo "From commit ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" - echo "On branch ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}" - echo "Pipeline ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}" - echo "Triggered by ${GITLAB_USER_LOGIN}" - echo "" - echo "Deployment steps:" - echo "1. Pull image ${DEPLOY_IMAGE}" - echo "2. Stop current containers" - echo "3. Start new containers" - echo "4. Run health checks" - echo "" - echo "Deployment completed successfully" environment: name: staging url: https://staging.example.com needs: - build_app - unit_tests - integration_tests only: - main - master
